review_scope: Historical static inventory retained; every record reclassified for the user-authorized FE-only release. No BE enforcement or universal bypass closure is claimed.
review_limits: Initial 700 candidates, all 1423 record identities and 1171 source hashes are preserved; counts are historical inventory, not active task counts or test coverage.
691 function registrations retain only FE resolution/classification/dispatch admission; BE function implementations and per-row checks are excluded.
All BE HTTP/RPC/service declarations and BE dependency routes are out_of_scope_user_accepted, including shared Thrift declarations whose names alone do not imply an independent listener.
Original hook/evidence and C references are historical provenance. Only current_hook/current_plan_refs and the current C disposition define implementation scope.
Existing authentication remains; adding a cluster identity system, execution credentials, leases, anti-replay or general service hardening is not a P0-P5 deliverable for this release.
FE Flight and background lifecycle are additionally anchored in the C-item map; the 1423 records do not inventory every source method.
Source inventory and acceptance of residual direct-BE access do not quantify exploit likelihood or prove any route safe.
Entry integration, FE-only functional/compatibility/performance validation and real release evidence remain pending. Existing isolated core tests are not copied into entry-level test_ids.
Eight UI sites remain planned integration points, not a completed certificate page.

release_scope.name: FE-only
release_scope.source: 用户明确接受旧计划复用风险，要求本版不修改 BE。
included: FE 证书签发交付配套、导入/验签、时间/持久化/多 FE 一致性
FE SQL/HTTP/Flight 等新查询和新计划准入，保留写入、事务和安全元数据
FE 管理完整已登记 FE/BE 名额，实际 DROP 提交后释放
FE 证书详情与导入页面以及真实功能、兼容和性能验证
excluded: BE 代码与许可检查，包括执行、扫描、取数、HTTP 下载、心跳和本地写入执行
新增跨 FE/BE 或 BE/BE 执行凭证、范围凭证、租约、反重放或节点身份体系
全库通用服务认证及历史安全问题加固，不因许可功能顺带更换通信协议
accepted_limitations: 到期前已下发外部计划可以在到期后向 BE 重新创建扫描；本版不强制计划单次使用。
已有 Flight BE DoGet、BE 直接 RPC/下载等入口保持现有行为，不声明许可层全部封堵。
后续向 FE 申请新的查询/计划按届时许可状态判断；DROP 释放名额不等于孤立旧 BE 进程即时失能。
风险接受来自用户决策，未测量发生概率，不将低概率或不可利用视为验证结论。
release_scope.runtime_implementation_status: FE entrypoint integration remains planned; isolated certificate primitive tests are recorded separately, not credited to these 1423 entries.

coverage_item_dispositions.current_requirement: 新增 FE SQL 证书导入、校验、查询及 ADMIN 权限、转发与脱敏。
在 FE 表达式解析与折叠前分类字典读取；不修改 BE 函数。
FE TVF 实例化、外部枚举、schema 推断前按用途准入。
FE 仅规划与写入准备保留，业务值求值按读取准入。
FE 真实出队后、首次执行分发前检查；拒绝后归还队列和查询资源。
FE 每次新 EXECUTE、缓存返回、点查和重试按同一执行生命周期处理；不向 BE 新增凭证。
FE 各入口、转发和异常包装保留稳定许可错误；不以 fallback 绕过。
FE 保留现有账号权限与转发入口的许可判断；不新增节点身份体系、服务认证协议或执行凭证签发链。
BE fragment、点查、fetch/cache/rowid/表达式 RPC 不新增许可校验。
FE _query_plan 新申请检查当前许可；已发计划可跨到期交 BE 再次开扫描，BE open_scanner/get_next 不改。
FE getBinlog/getSnapshot 新业务读取请求执行许可检查，保留原写入/恢复；不重构 token 协议、不封堵 BE 文件下载。
BE 文件下载、批量、续传和目录范围凭证退出本版。
